\begin{itemize}

$$
\begin{aligned}
|\overrightarrow{P R}| & =|\overrightarrow{Q R}| \\

|-6 \mathbf{i}+t-2 \mathbf{k}| & =|-5 \mathbf{i}+(t+3) \mathbf{j}-6 \mathbf{k}| \\
\sqrt{(-6)^{2}+t^{2}+(-2)^{2}} & =\sqrt{(-5)^{2}+(t+3)^{2}+(-6)^{2}} \\
t^{2}+40 & =t^{2}+6 t+70 \\
t & =-5
\end{aligned}
$$
\end{itemize}
\begin{itemize}
\item[（b）] $\overrightarrow{P Q} \times \overrightarrow{P R}$
$$
\begin{aligned}
= & (-\mathbf{i}-3 \mathbf{j}+4 \mathbf{k}) \times(-6 \mathbf{i}-5 \mathbf{j}-2 \mathbf{k}) \\
= & \left|\begin{array}{ccc}
\mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\
-1 & -3 & 4 \\
-6 & -5 & -2
\end{array}\right| \\
= & {[(-3)(-2)-(4)(-5)] \mathbf{i}-[(-1)(-2)-(-6)(4)] \mathbf{j} } \\
& +[(-1)(-5)-(-6)(-3)] \mathbf{k} \\
= & 26 \mathbf{i}-26 \mathbf{j}-13 \mathbf{k}
\end{aligned}
$$
\item[（c）] The volume of the tetrahedron $O P Q R$
四面體 $O P Q R$ 的體積
$$
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{6}|\overrightarrow{O P} \cdot(\overrightarrow{P Q} \times \overrightarrow{P R})| \\
& =\frac{1}{6}|(\mathbf{i}-2 \mathbf{k}) \cdot(26 \mathbf{i}-26 \mathbf{j}-13 \mathbf{k})| \\
& =\frac{1}{6}|(1)(26)+(-2)(-13)| \\
& =\frac{26}{3}
\end{aligned}
$$
\end{itemize}
\begin{itemize}
\item[（d）] （i）By（c），the volume of the tetrahedron $O P Q R$ is not equal to zero．
藉（c），四面體 $O P Q R$ 的體積不等於零。

and 以及

$$
and 以及
$$
\begin{aligned}

{[-\mathbf{i}+(z+2) \mathbf{k}] \cdot(26 \mathbf{i}-26 \mathbf{j}-13 \mathbf{k}) } & =0 \\
-26-13 z-26 & =0 \\

$$
Thus，we have 由此，可得
$$
\begin{gathered}
\overrightarrow{X Y}=\overrightarrow{O Y}-\overrightarrow{O X}=-2 \mathbf{i}-2 \mathbf{j} \\

-2 & -2 & 0 \\

$$
The area of $\triangle X Y Z$

& =\frac{1}{2} \sqrt{8^{2}+(-8)^{2}+(-4)^{2}} \\

$$
